# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.3.0

Adds real-person authorization to the CLI and local MCP: show a private verification link and offline QR image, query the result, upload reference media to the authorized person's group, and wait until the asset is ready for generation.

- Bundles Segno 1.6.6 and its BSD-3-Clause license. Installation requires no additional Python packages; release files are verified with SHA-256.
- Keeps provider tokens and internal identifiers out of public responses. QR cache files use user-only permissions and expire without a background service.
- Preserves the existing Seedance 2.5 and Seed Audio capability snapshot, API Key setup, credit estimation, and one-confirmation/one-generation submission rule.

The production API and official browser callback must support this flow. Human verification is performed by the person and does not constitute consent to paid generation.
